Name: Mind's Eye
Effect: At night time, all Moves used by this Pokémon are considered to have the “Never Miss” Added Effect. It can hit Ghost-Type Pokémon with Normal-Type and Fighting-Type Moves, dealing Regular Damage.
Description: With an unparalleled cosmic awareness, this Pokémon is able to see the future accurately. It is said you can see your own demise by looking into its dead eye.
